title: Going to — future plans
examples: I am going to take the train.
She is going to book a ticket.
We are going to the cinema.
pattern: am / is / are + going to + base verb
explanation: Use going to for future plans and intentions you have already decided.
explanationIt: Usa going to per piani e intenzioni future già decise.
realUse: I am going to take the train tomorrow.
We are going to visit Florence.
He is going to buy a ticket.

options: I am going to take the train.
I going to take the train.
I am go to take the train.
I am going take the train.
exercises.answer: I am going to take the train.
exercises.explanation: Use am/is/are + going to + base verb.

exercises.prompt: She ____ going to book the tickets tonight.
Fix: We are going visit Rome.
options: We are going to visit Rome.
We are go to visit Rome.
exercises.answer: We are going to visit Rome.
